notes.title: Astronimo Demo Hotfix 2 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]

[list][*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash in an online game when abandoning a challenge while grabbing a battery with a claw.[/list][list][*] Fixed a bug where the game crashed on the main menu.[/list][list][*] Solved some graphic issues experienced by players.[/list][list][*] Improvements to our bug reporter tool.[/list]

notes.title: Astronimo Demo Hotfix NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Thanks for all your feedback. Here is a list of fixes the team has been working on: 

[b]Workshop[/b]

[list]
[*] Solved several issues where the player crashed while building in the workshop
[/list] [list]
[*] Solved an issue where players would crash when joining an online game while other players were entering or exiting the workshop.
[/list] [list]
[*] Solved a rare crash experienced by all players after deploying a contraption in the Turilia Subverse challenge.
[/list] [list]
[*] Players should no longer experience a rare crash when attempting to load a deployed contraption. 
[/list] [list]
[*] Rods no longer disappear when players use shortcuts in different workshop slots.
[/list] [list]
[*] Rod movement no longer resets when multiple players are building in different workshop slots. 
[/list]

[b]Online / Gameplay[/b]

[list]
[*] Solved an issue where the Host would crash after prolonged gameplay.
[/list] [list]
[*] Clients will no longer crash when canceling a long loading screen. 
[/list] [list]
[*] Clients will no longer crash when joining an online game at the same time a challenge is being completed. 
[/list] [list]
[*] Players should no longer crash when dying while holding a battery.
[/list] [list]
[*] Players should no longer experience infrequent crashes on saving and exiting after forming or joining an online game. 
[/list] [list]
[*] Players will see the correct number of Subverse teleporter buttons if players disconnect during an online session.
[/list] [list]
[*] Connection timeout duration increased when attempting to connect to online services.
[/list] [list]
[*] Changed how some files are packaged during installation to resolve an issue causing players to crash on boot.
[/list]

[b]Community Moon[/b]

[list]
[*] Community Moon level editor no longer softlocks when closing the welcome message using the X in the pop up box. 
[/list]

We hope this improves your experience. If you have any further issues or feedback, please use the in-game report feature, or you can join our Discord Community [url=https://discord.gg/coatsink]here[/url]
